utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Which repair drive are we talking about, and what exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve been hearing it’s the one for the community center roof and the busted hallway lights. Folks were saying they need tools, a ladder, and a few hands this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—who’s organizing it, and where exactly should people show up this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand or some tools, and I’ll keep it practical. Just point me to the next repair that needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — sorry, I’ve been behind on updates. Let’s start with the next repair you think is most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’d start with anything safety-related first — loose steps, leaking pipes, or shaky wiring. Point me at the worst one and I’ll get to work.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive might be getting a pretty good turnout, but I’m still waiting to hear the final details. I’ll let you know as soon as I know more.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That makes sense — I’d just like the final details as soon as they’re set so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along the final details the moment I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What needs fixin’ first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s start with the driveway crack by the east side gate — it’s the one that’s been widening near the curb. I’m pretty sure that’s the first thing we should tackle.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, that sounds like the first one to tackle — the driveway crack by the east side gate near the curb. I’ll take a look and get it patched up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Count me in — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and get folks turning up fast.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks. I’m still waiting on a few details before I say more.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No rush — send me the details when you have them, and I’ll keep helping get people lined up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m on it, Leo — I’ll keep everyone updated on the repair drive and make sure the details stay straight. If anything changes, I’ll flag it in the group chat right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Just keep it simple and let me know if anything slips.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep it simple and let you know right away if anything slips.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d want to verify the details first before we act on anything. What exactly needs repair on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not sure yet — I only caught bits of it. I can help piece it together if you tell me what’s been said so far.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — let’s stick to what’s confirmed. So far, all I know is that something on the drive needs repair, but I don’t have the specifics yet.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep it around school pickup—what time window are we working with?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That should work — we were aiming for late afternoon, after school pickup. If you can do 3:30 to 5:00, I’ll make the plan fit around that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:30 to 5:00 works for me. I can be there right after pickup and help for that window.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive from folks nearby — what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve heard it’s moving along nicely, but I don’t have the full rundown yet. I can check with a couple folks and pass along whatever’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules — that’d be really helpful. I’m still piecing it together, so even a small update would be great.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m on it—just give me the quick version of the repair drive, and I’ll keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not changing my stance without confirmation—what exactly is the repair drive, and what’s your source for that?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m just going off what you told me earlier, and I’m asking for the quick summary so I can keep this moving. If you want, tell me the key point and I’ll stick to that.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still thinking it through, but I’m leaning toward a quiet repair drive rather than a big public push. What part are you most concerned about?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m mostly worried we’ll forget a few of the small fixes and confuse the timing, to be honest. But I’ll go along with what you think best, Rey.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense — let’s keep it simple and make a short checklist so the small fixes don’t slip through. I’ll draft the timing and you can poke holes in it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We should keep it simple: line up the repairs, let folks know the timing, and get the drive moving. If that’s the plan everyone’s on, I’m all in and happy to spread it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That sounds right to me; I’ll note the repair list and timing so I don’t miss anything. Once it’s settled, I can help let folks know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll keep repeating that plan: repairs first, timing second, then we spread the word and get the drive rolling.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s picking up steam—folks are dropping off tools, spare parts, and a few good stories besides. If you want, I can swing by and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be helpful, thanks. If you see them, ask whether they need any extension cords or a socket set too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do—I’ll ask about extension cords and a socket set when I pass by. If I hear anything else they’re short on, I’ll bring it back your way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yes, the repair drive — that’s the one we’re doing soon, right? I’d better follow your lead on the details, Vik.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep — that’s the one, and I’ll keep everyone posted as we lock the details in. Once the plan’s set, I’ll repeat it around so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds good to me, Vik — I’ll just go with whatever you set. I’m sure you’ll keep us all straight when the details are final.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just need a hand with the repair drive. I’ll give you the details when I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — just send me the details when you’re there, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’m in — I can bring tools and help where I’m needed. Just point me at the biggest job and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Gus. We’ll stick to the plan: start with the biggest job and work down the list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll start with the biggest job and keep moving down the list. Just let me know where to show up and I’ll be there with tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—let’s stick to the original plan and keep our promises. What’s the first thing you want me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—let’s keep the original plan front and center. Could you start by reaching out to the volunteer list and confirming who’s still in?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course—I’ll contact the volunteer list and confirm who’s still in, then I’ll report back with the names. I’ll keep it aligned with the original plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m really glad the repair drive is happening — it’s such a good way to pull folks together. If you want, I can help spread the word and get both groups involved.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’d love that. I’ll get you the exact details so we can keep both groups aligned and make this drive as effective as possible.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — send me the details and I’ll start sharing them around right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Just checking we’re still set for the repair drive—I can update the block chat if anything changed. Want me to confirm the final time and meeting spot?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please confirm the final time and meeting spot in the block chat. I’d like to keep my notes accurate.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll post the final time and meeting spot in the block chat now, and I’ll make sure it’s clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’m happy to help if you need another pair of hands with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell. What exactly do you want me to handle for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Could you let me know what still needs doing and where I’d be most useful? I’m still learning everyone’s routines, but I can help where I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m on it — I’ve got the gist of the repair drive and I’ll keep it moving between trips. Just point me to the next step when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — keep me posted, and I’ll fit the next step around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out between rides and let you know as soon as I’m at the next step.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Sam. Can you confirm exactly what needs fixing and send me the source or receipt for it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep — I can confirm what needs fixing and I’ll send over the source or receipt for it.
